name: Media Playback
description: Plays audio and video files of the binder inside the program: play controls in the editor's footer bar, Navigate > Media with keyboard shortcuts (Ctrl+Return plays or pauses while you type in the other editor), pause and rewind for transcription, playing speed, timestamps. Brings Qt Multimedia 6.4.2 and a decoding-only FFmpeg 6.1.1 (LGPL), so no other program is needed; GStreamer of the system can be chosen instead (Options > Behaviors > Playback).
author: Quillbinder
